data_audit.scope: 35 immutable runs; individual integrity plus configuration grouping

deterministic_replay.scope: two isolated DCU replicas, seed 57721, 1000 parcels
deterministic_replay.limitation: determinism does not establish spatial convergence or physical accuracy

confirmed_findings.detail: All 35 audited immutable runs passed file, manifest, length, mass, strict fallback, and strict hit-ratio checks.
The historical root contains four implementation/configuration groups and must not be pooled as one convergence series.
Independent DCU replicas produced byte-identical NPZ, summary, and manifest for the tested 1000-parcel replay.
The spatial field is supported by very few accepted impacts, so active-face variance remains the primary convergence risk.
Disabling exact near-miss distance diagnostics changed 5659 to 0 diagnostic events but did not change physical arrays or tracking summary and made the run 0.85 percent slower.

The dominant work is repeated CFD sampling and strict swept-segment broadphase/triangle testing. Midpoint integration causes two CFD samples per strict substep; near-miss distance diagnostics are a small tail of the work.

The performance A/B had median registration distance 3.435 mm and p95 5.181 mm, but only five exposed faces entered the comparison mask. This is not enough to support spatial accuracy. Historical runs with zero compared faces remain blocked.
Baseline and optimized NPZ containers and full canonical digests differ only through the expected particle_run_id provenance field; all physical arrays are equal.

root_cause_conclusion.primary: sparse accepted-impact support drives spatial Monte Carlo variance
root_cause_conclusion.secondary: strict tracking spends most time on repeated CFD KD-tree samples and swept-segment candidate tests
unresolved: whether dt or strict_max_substep can be relaxed without changing accepted impact support
whether nearest-cell interpolation is an acceptable performance/physics tradeoff
CFD-to-reference registration and normal/angle semantics for a larger active comparison mask
current-code hit-support convergence at the declared production particle count
